extract_template_features: extract template atom positions and masks from an mmCIF object aligned to a query sequence
process_single_hit: process a single HHSearch hit to extract template features from the corresponding mmCIF file
assess_hhsearch_hit: assess whether an HHSearch hit passes prefilter checks for date, alignment ratio, and duplicates
find_template_in_pdb: find a template chain in a parsed mmCIF object by exact, sequence-only, or fuzzy match
get_templates_hhsearch: compute template features from HHSearch hits using HhsearchHitFeaturizer with a max date and max hits limit
